name: edge_flange_closes_the_side
why: ENTRY GP18, the third operation of the family. On the L of the sheet-metal cases (50 + 30, 40 deep, T 2, R 2) a 90 degree flange on the edge at the end of the 50 leg, 25 long to the outer virtual sharp. The probe `Checks/EdgeFlange` measured it before it was written: it is born only with a profile RECTANGLE on the end face, and the flat pattern grows by (L - R - T) + BA - (R + T), to the thousandth, with 22 and with 32.
_the_edges_by_where_they_are: The L goes from x -2 to 50 and from y -2 to 30: the edge at the end of the 50 leg on the inner face is at x = 50, y = 0, along Z for 40.

expect.tolerance_why: read back from the flange in metres
(25 - 2 - 2) + pi/2 * (2 + 0.5 * 2) - (2 + 2) = 21.712 mm of extra flat pattern, over 2 of thickness and 40 of edge. Measured with the probe at 22 and 32: 1497 and 2297, equal to the calculation
80.712 + 21.712: the flattened strip is the long side of the flat part
